whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Alpine Restaurant & Rooftop,

I noticed your restaurant has amazing 4.5★ reviews from 650+ patrons in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and rooftop event bookings.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, rooftop dining specials, aur menu showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://alpine-restaurant-demo.preview-url

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Alpine Restaurant & Rooftop, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table reservation and rooftop dining showcase for your location in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact food menu, actual ambience photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
